differences.a_observable: The blue button on the right is a lighter, less saturated blue.
differences.b_observable: The blue button on the right is a highly saturated royal blue.
differences.fix: Desaturate and lighten the blue button material.

differences.a_observable: The background keys have softer shadows and brighter highlights.
differences.b_observable: The background keys show darker shadows in crevices and higher contrast.
differences.fix: Increase ambient light and soften shadows on the keyboard grid.

differences.a_observable: The corners of the frame show significant out-of-focus blur.
differences.b_observable: The corners of the frame are sharp and in focus.
differences.fix: Enable a shallower depth of field to blur the corners.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust camera aperture to replicate the shallow depth of field and corner blur of the reference.
